non_negotiable_contracts: Actual work overrides never change compensation based on the informed assignment. For a new same-code Work Period, the latest prior WORKED assignment supplies actual Sector, Location and Task as proposed values, with per-field informed fallback; existing assignments and Journey defaults are not rewritten.
Bite 35.4 contains separate customer-facing functional and technical operational readiness; customer training is in Brazilian Portuguese.

Initial Journeys start at zero; historical BRL and GOLD_GRAM amounts owed to or by Collaborators are introduced through an explicitly approved, auditable, one-time Opening Balance Adjustment CSV import, not Bonuses.
Initialize Production only through a guarded procedure rehearsed on Test; do not use demo/reset commands to replace the live Production database.
Named human Application Administrator enrollment uses existing controlled mechanisms; no fabricated second administrator or self-approval bypass.
1Password is the sole ERS operational credential-custody system; LastPass references are legacy and must be resolved in launch runbooks.
Preserve the existing Hetzner ERS Backups project and ers bucket; never assert advanced environment isolation was accepted.
No real customer data before the six minimum safety gates pass.
